title: Water Representation Lab

scope.baseline: R4B Canvas2D implementation; R4B not modified.
scope.allowed: Water representation and restrained water flow only.

confirmed_r4b_root_cause.diagnosis: R4B sampled the original photograph at displaced coordinates, preserving its baked concentric/radial ripple geometry.
confirmed_r4b_root_cause.r4c_response: D samples the reconstructed C buffer rather than the original source buffer.

renderer.rationale: The R3/R4 real-photo Canvas2D path is proven on phone and keeps the representation lab inspectable.

C.output: B plus seeded four-way blends of valid-water photographic residuals.

D.output: Restrained macro/meso/micro flow applied only to C.

boundary_protection.attenuation: Smooth boundary field approaches zero at shoreline, island, rocks, wood, and other static exclusions.
boundary_protection.bilinear_guard: All four source-footprint pixels must be valid water.

runtime.lifecycle: No elapsed-time reset on pause/background; foreground refreshes timestamp.

remaining_risks: B may be too smooth or retain broad ring evidence.
C may show residual mosaic or repeated texture.
D may still expose a recognizable pattern.
phone_test_procedure: Compare A to B for radial-center suppression.
Hold C static for 10 seconds and inspect seams/anchors.
Only then run D for 10–20 seconds.
Read diagnostics separately from the visual verdict.
